title: Add precision guards for systematic agent false-positive patterns
summary: Quality rules now include precision guards to prevent the agent from emitting documented false-positive patterns, such as missing tooltips on bound page fields, misunderstanding of Boolean page trigger defaults, and incorrectly flagging unfiltered drilldowns.
key_points: Added precision guards to suppress four recurring false-positive findings that BC reviewers confirmed: missing tooltips on bound fields (inherit from table), Boolean page triggers defaulting to true, effective filters outside the diff, and CalcFields in different lifecycle triggers
Breaking-change and upgrade reviews now require that affected symbols actually shipped in a released version, preventing false positives for new or unreleased-cycle apps
Guards are narrowly scoped and documented with developer confirmation from evaluation feedback
Direction is strictly conservative without suppressing genuine knowledge-backed findings
Two BC developers confirmed the page-trigger default-return semantics
